chunks: Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i ibn Abdullah, from al-Fuzayl ibn Yasar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah, Majestic and Mighty: 'His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth' [2:255].
So he said: 'O Fuzayl! Everything is in the Kursi — the heavens and the earth, and everything is in the Kursi.'

key_terms.الْكُرْسِيُّ: Kursi — literally 'chair' or 'throne', a cosmological term signifying divine dominion encompassing all creation
key_terms.جَلَّ وَعَزَّ: Majestic and Mighty — common honorific formula used when referring to God
key_terms.وَسِعَ: Extended over/encompassed — denotes the limitless expanse of divine sovereignty

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the Kursi (throne) of Allah in Ayat al-Kursi?
ai.summary: In this hadith, al-Fuzayl ibn Yasar, a trusted companion, asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the meaning of the famous Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), specifically the phrase 'His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth.' The Imam's response affirms the absolute cosmic comprehensiveness of the Divine Kursi, emphasizing that not only the heavens and earth but everything in existence is contained within it. This teaching reflects the Shia theological tradition of understanding Quranic cosmological terms through the authoritative interpretation of the Imams, with the Imam directly addressing his companion al-Fuzayl ibn Yasar by name.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabie Bin Abdullah, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj Majestic and Mighty [2:255] His Chair extends over the skies and the earth.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Fuzayl! Everything is in the Chair (الْكُرْسِيِّ). The skies, and the earth and everything, is in the Chair (الْكُرْسِيِّ)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Isma‘il has narrated from Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rabi‘i ibn ‘Abdallah from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following.
“I asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, “His al-Kursi (the Throne) encompasses the heavens and earth.”
He said, “O Fudayl everything is the al-Kursi (the Throne), the heavens and earth everything is in al-Kursi.”
